channel.title: Ugur Tuna – Essays on AI
channel.description: Practitioner essays on AI evaluation, agentic runtime controls, model routing TCO, and keeping human judgement in charge.

item.title: Usage is not quality: what to measure when you roll out AI
item.description: Active-user telemetry tracks exposure, not value. Define task criteria upfront, isolate claims against cited text, and put checking effort in the same table as quality.

item.title: Read freely, write carefully: controls for AI agents that act
item.description: Authorise tool calls in code outside the model using allow/draft/approve/block policies, SQLite atomic limits, execution-time re-validation, hash-chained audit logs, and kill switches.

item.title: A second model is a critic, not a verifier
item.description: Model critique improves drafts, but shared blind spots mean agreement is not proof. Separate writers from cross-family graders, isolate cited passages, and check Cohen's kappa against human labels.

item.title: Why you should write your own prompts
item.description: Borrowed mega-prompts hide silent assumptions and blind self-refinement degrades code. Write plain, versioned prompt specifications and co-evolve a fixed test suite beside them.

item.title: A partner, not a button: keeping judgement in AI workflows
item.description: Frequent approval pop-ups breed rubber-stamping fatigue. Replace generic dialogs with deterministic automation for plumbing, reversible draft mode for judgement, and full payload previews.

item.title: Beyond code: what most people actually need from AI
item.description: Five-sixths of conversational AI outputs sit outside software engineering, in memos, analysis, and policy—where there is no compiler and governance relies on clear YAML boundaries.

item.title: Token price is a trap: pricing AI routing by total cost
item.description: Token rate cards hide checking and rework costs while blind all-frontier routing overpays. Enforce residency gates first, then choose model mixes on evaluation evidence and total cost.
